defs.def: also; in addition to 和；与；同；又；而

ex.s: When attending an event at SoFi Stadium, you’re just a short walk or ride from several comfortable and classy hotels.
ex.t: 在SoFi体育场参加活动时，步行或乘车一小段路就能到达几家舒适而高档的酒店。

ex.s: Right across the street, Sonder Lüim Hotel offers spacious rooms and a rooftop pool.
ex.t: 就在街对面，Sonder Lüim酒店提供宽敞的客房和屋顶泳池。

ex.s: For those seeking both comfort and convenience, the Renaissance Los Angeles Airport Hotel is just a short drive away.
ex.t: 对于既追求舒适又讲究便利的人来说，洛杉矶机场万丽酒店只需短途车程即可到达。

ex.s: If you’re willing to drive a little further, the Ritz-Carlton Los Angeles promises luxurious rooms and extensive leisure facilities — perfect for turning a game day into a great weekend escape.
ex.t: 如果你愿意开得稍远一点，洛杉矶丽思卡尔顿酒店承诺提供豪华客房和丰富的休闲设施——非常适合把比赛日变成一次很棒的周末出游。

ex.s: SoFi Stadium requires you to park strictly in your assigned zone, and guests must enter through the exact gate indicated on their color-coded digital parking pass.
ex.t: SoFi体育场要求你严格在指定区域停车，并且宾客必须通过其彩色编码电子停车证上标明的确切入口进入。

ex.s: If you enter through the wrong access point, you'll be turned around and redirected — so plan ahead.
ex.t: 如果你从错误的入口进入，会被拦下并重新指引——所以请提前规划。

ex.s: For those wishing to park near friends, all vehicles must have passes for the same zone and arrive together — spaces cannot be saved.
ex.t: 对于想把车停在朋友附近的人，所有车辆必须持有同一区域的停车证并同时到达——车位不能预留。

ex.s: I looked pointedly at the bookshelf that held at least three dictionaries, and Kevin sighed dramatically.
ex.t: 我特意看了看那个至少放着三本词典的书架，凯文夸张地叹了口气。

ex.s: I continued to make these pencil marks for years, and when I went off to college, I packed that dictionary in my suitcase.
ex.t: 多年来我一直做着这些铅笔标记，离家上大学时，我把那本词典装进了行李箱。

ex.s: And it wasn't, ultimately, the dictionary that got me there — not really.
ex.t: 说到底，真正让我走到今天的并不是那本词典——并不是。

ex.s: It’s not about the words themselves or how we learn them, but the wanting to know them, the curiosity and the appetite.
ex.t: 关键不在于单词本身或我们怎么学它们，而在于想要了解它们的愿望、好奇心和渴望。

ex.s: They provide shade, lower surface temperatures, absorb a surprising amount of airborne carbon, remove tiny pollutants, and provide wildlife habitat along with just plain beauty.
ex.t: 它们提供树荫、降低地表温度、吸收可观的空气中的碳、清除微小污染物，并提供野生动物栖息地，还有纯粹的美的享受。

ex.s: Oaks and sweetgums, which currently account for a majority of the city’s trees, produce huge amounts of a chemical substance called isoprene.
ex.t: 目前占城市树木大多数的橡树和枫香树，会释放大量一种叫做异戊二烯的化学物质。

ex.s: The research, carried out by scientists at the Columbia Climate School and other institutions, found that if the city maintains past species patterns in new plantings, isoprene production in Manhattan in coming decades will go up by about 140%, and resulting summer ozone levels as much as 30%.
ex.t: 这项由哥伦比亚气候学院及其他机构的科学家开展的研究发现，如果该市在新种植中沿用过去的树种模式，未来几十年曼哈顿的异戊二烯产量将上升约140%，由此导致的夏季臭氧水平最多将上升30%。

ex.s: “We’re not going to go cutting down any big old oaks,” and neither will the department completely stop planting new ones, said Auyeung.
ex.t: “我们不会去砍任何一棵高大的老橡树，”Auyeung说，管理局也不会完全停止种植新树。

ex.s: What does the new study imply regarding oaks and sweetgums?
ex.t: 关于橡树和枫香树，这项新研究暗示了什么？

ex.s: Participants were randomly divided into two groups: the “beauty” group was asked to actively consider and then rate the beauty of each object they viewed, while the control group just matched a line drawing of the object with the artwork itself.
ex.t: 参与者被随机分为两组：“美”组被要求主动思考并为所看到的每件物品的美打分，而对照组只是将物品的线描图与艺术品本身进行匹配。

ex.s: Across all participants, those in the beauty group reported an average of 23% higher levels of “transformative and self-transcendent feelings” — such as feeling moved, enlightened and inspired — than the control group.
ex.t: 在所有参与者中，“美”组报告的“蜕变与超越自我的感受”——如感动、顿悟和受启发——平均比对照组高出23%。

ex.s: “It’s becoming much rarer to zone out and just let the mind wander, but that’s when we think in ways that broaden our minds.
ex.t: “放空自己、任思绪自由漫游的机会越来越少，但那正是我们以开阔思维的方式思考的时候。

ex.s: AI transforms a standard museum trip into a personalized and interactive adventure.
ex.t: 人工智能把一次普通的博物馆之行变成个性化、互动性的探索体验。

ex.s: In addition to being venues for buying and selling, daji are occasions for socializing and entertainment.
ex.t: 除了作为买卖场所，大集也是社交和娱乐的场合。

ex.s: While eating and enjoying street performances, they chat with each other and share stories of their daily lives.
ex.t: 人们一边吃吃喝喝、欣赏街头表演，一边相互聊天，分享日常生活的故事。

ex.s: As the snow came down more and more heavily, Emily was directed off the highway.
ex.t: 雪越下越大，Emily被引导驶离了高速公路。

ex.s: She drove on for a while and found herself on an unfamiliar road toward a Canadian town.
ex.t: 她又开了一会儿，发现自己走上了一条通往加拿大小镇的陌生道路。

ex.s: After a struggle, she managed to free the vehicle and continued inching along the snow-covered road.
ex.t: 一番挣扎后，她设法把车弄了出来，继续在积雪覆盖的道路上缓慢前行。

ex.s: When Emily rolled down the window, Rachel asked if she was okay and told her it was not safe to stay overnight in the car.
ex.t: 当Emily摇下车窗时，Rachel问她是否还好，并告诉她整夜待在车里不安全。

ex.s: Grateful and relieved, Emily accepted the offer.
ex.t: 满怀感激和如释重负的埃米莉接受了这个提议。

ex.s: Daniel and Rachel suggested that Emily continue her journey by train.
ex.t: Daniel和Rachel建议Emily乘火车继续旅程。

ex.s: Dandan noodles and mapo tofu are sure bets.
ex.t: 担担面和麻婆豆腐是绝对不会踩雷的选择。

ex.s: Panda Gourmet offers online ordering for takeout, and delivery is now an option.
ex.t: Panda Gourmet提供外卖在线点餐，现在也支持配送。

ex.s: It also serves a variety of chef’s specials, beef with rice cakes, and more.
ex.t: 它还供应各种主厨特色菜、年糕炒牛肉等。

ex.s: The restaurant is open from 11:00 am to 9:00 pm Tuesday through Sunday, offering call-in orders and pickups.
ex.t: 餐厅周二至周日上午11:00至晚上9:00营业，接受电话订餐和自取。

ex.s: The spacious dining room is regularly filled with customers enjoying dumplings and a variety of noodle and rice dishes.
ex.t: 宽敞的餐厅里经常坐满享用饺子以及各种面食和米饭菜肴的顾客。

ex.s: Dinner hours: Tuesday through Thursday 5:30 pm — 9:00 pm (last seating); Friday and Saturday 5:00 pm — 9:30 pm (last seating).
ex.t: 晚餐时间：周二至周四下午5:30—晚上9:00（最后入座）；周五、周六下午5:00—晚上9:30（最后入座）。

ex.s: Closed on Sunday and Monday.
ex.t: 周日、周一休息。

ex.s: Roland Reisley turned 101 years old in May and is in remarkable health.
ex.t: Roland Reisley今年5月满101岁，身体状况非常好。

ex.s: Back in 1951, Reisley was just 26, newly married and ready to put down roots.
ex.t: 早在1951年，Reisley只有26岁，新婚不久，准备安家扎根。

ex.s: He and his wife began looking for a place in Manhattan.
ex.t: 他和妻子开始物色曼哈顿的一处住所。

ex.s: But what they liked, they couldn’t afford on his sound engineer’s salary and what they could, they didn’t like.
ex.t: 但他们喜欢的，靠他音响工程师的工资买不起；而买得起的，他们又不喜欢。

ex.s: It is made with local materials, has a flat roof, wood paneling, concrete floors and custom-made furniture.
ex.t: 它使用当地材料建造，有平屋顶、木镶板、混凝土地面和定制家具。

ex.s: Reisley believes that his devotion to the home and the community are what have kept him in such good health all of these years.
ex.t: Reisley相信，正是对这座房子和这片社区的热爱，让他多年来一直保持着如此好的健康状态。

ex.s: Simple readings are now readily available on our phones and wearables.
ex.t: 如今，我们的手机和可穿戴设备都能轻松给出这些简单读数。

ex.s: Appropriately, the book took shape during a summer spent between sea and mountains.
ex.t: 恰如其分地，这本书是在一个穿梭于海与山之间的夏天里成形的。

ex.s: A month after visiting the French Riviera and enjoying the sandy beaches of Nice and Menton, I went hiking with friends in the Pala group.
ex.t: 在游览法国里维埃拉、享受尼斯和芒通沙滩一个月后，我和朋友去Pala山群徒步。

ex.s: Mountains to Seas: Ups and Downs
ex.t: 《从山到海：起起伏伏》

ex.s: The Barcelona subway pulls into the station, the doors slide open and passengers pour out to go about their daily business.
ex.t: 巴塞罗那地铁驶入车站，门滑开，乘客涌出，去忙各自日常的事。

ex.s: Barcelona has put together a package of clean energy technologies to help public transportation go greener, while also doing its part to tackle climate change and aid Europe’s difficult shift to the privately owned electric vehicle market.
ex.t: 巴塞罗那已经汇集了一整套清洁能源技术,以帮助公共交通走向绿色,同时也在应对气候变化并帮助欧洲艰难地转向私人拥有的电动车辆市场方面尽了自己的职责。

ex.s: Regenerative brakes have been in trains for decades and are also used in some cars.
ex.t: 再生制动技术在列车中已应用了几十年，一些汽车也在使用。

ex.s: Here are four simple and practical ways.
ex.t: 这里有四个简单实用的方法。

ex.s: If your child sees you enjoying your work and taking pride in a job well done, they’re far more likely to do the same.
ex.t: 如果你的孩子看到你享受工作并为把事情做好感到自豪，他们也更有可能这样做。

ex.s: Progress can be slow, and you’ll wonder if it’s all sinking in.
ex.t: 进步可能很慢，你会怀疑这一切是否真的被他们吸收了。

ex.s: Although not a morning person, I begin my lesson with Angela and about twenty others at a Sydney community centre courtyard at 7 am.
ex.t: 虽然不是早起的人，我还是在早上7点和安吉拉以及另外约二十人在悉尼一个社区中心的院子里开始上课。

ex.s: In tai chi, the dan tian is your qi core and qi in Chinese means life force.
ex.t: 在太极拳中，丹田是你的气之核心，而“气”在中文里意为生命力。

ex.s: I found comfort in keeping myself awake when everyone else had gone to bed, and I loved the silence of the night.
ex.t: 用大写字母写的“安静”标志到处都是。如果她觉得你穿得不合适，她会直接让你回家换衣服。

ex.s: I still loved the night and would stay up until unruly hours for no apparent reason, chatting online and watching videos.
ex.t: 我依然热爱夜晚，会无缘无故熬到离谱的时间，上网聊天、看视频。

ex.s: Bent over my laptop while sitting on the bed in the corner of my room, I suddenly felt a pounding headache, and had to lie down.
ex.t: 我弓着背坐在房间角落的床上盯着笔记本电脑，突然感到一阵剧烈的头痛，不得不躺下。

ex.s: Often students come to the classroom believing that learning can’t be fun and that what they learn isn’t relevant to the real world — much less to their personal interests.
ex.t: 学生们常常带着这样的看法走进教室：学习不可能有趣，所学内容与现实世界无关——更谈不上与他们的个人兴趣有关。

ex.s: I’ve discovered that if I show students how what they learn is relevant to my hobbies, they’re much more willing to make connections to their personal interests and develop their own hobbies.
ex.t: 我发现，如果我向学生展示所学内容与我的爱好的关联，他们就更愿意把知识与自己的兴趣联系起来，并培养出自己的爱好。

ex.s: When I first brought my hobbies to my classroom, I was focused on how doing so would build engagement and help my students understand concepts in science.
ex.t: 最初把爱好带进课堂时，我关注的是这样做能如何提高参与度、帮助学生理解科学概念。

ex.s: When I let them see an aspect of my life outside of school, some students who were also interested in cars connected with me more and became more engaged in my courses.
ex.t: 当我让他们看到我校外生活的一面时，一些同样对汽车感兴趣的学生与我更有共鸣，也更投入我的课程。

ex.s: I find that doing so energizes my instruction, engages my students, and demonstrates to them how abstract concepts play out in the real world.
ex.t: 我发现，这样做让我的教学更有活力，让学生更投入，也向他们展示了抽象概念在现实世界中的实际运用。

ex.s: The gap between teachers’ and students’ hobbies.
ex.t: 老师与学生爱好之间的差距。

ex.s: Consumers enjoy reading and giving reviews.
ex.t: 消费者喜欢阅读和撰写评价。

ex.s: Shabnam Azimi and Alexander Krasnikov of Loyola University of Chicago and Kwong Chan of Northeastern University recently published a study on fake reviews.
ex.t: 芝加哥洛约拉大学的Shabnam Azimi、Alexander Krasnikov和东北大学的Kwong Chan最近发表了一项关于虚假评论的研究。

ex.s: Each subject got eight reviews to read: a balanced set of two positive fake, two positive real, two negative fake and two negative real, presented in a random order.
ex.t: 每位受试者读了八条评论：均衡地包含两条正面虚假、两条正面真实、两条负面虚假和两条负面真实，以随机顺序呈现。

ex.s: A lengthy, positive review, on the other hand, was regarded as suspicious, and participants tended to trust writers that kept their glowing reviews short.
ex.t: 另一方面，一条冗长而正面的评价被认为是可疑的，参与者倾向于信任那些保持他们热情洋溢的评论简短的作家。

ex.s: In a study published in Plant Phenomics, Busch and Pereira establish a new procedure for using SLEAP to analyze plant root phenotypes — how deep and wide they grow, how massive their root systems become, and other physical qualities.
ex.t: 在发表于《Plant Phenomics》的一项研究中，Busch和Pereira建立了一种使用SLEAP分析植物根表型的新流程——包括它们长得有多深多宽、根系变得多庞大，以及其他物理特征。

ex.s: Prior to SLEAP, tracking the physical characteristics of both plants and animals required a lot of labor that slowed the scientific process.
ex.t: 在SLEAP出现之前，追踪动植物物理特征需要大量人工，拖慢了科研进程。

ex.s: SLEAP uses computer vision (the ability for computers to understand images) and deep learning (an AI approach for training a computer to learn and work like the human brain) to help researchers process images much more quickly.
ex.t: SLEAP使用计算机视觉（计算机理解图像的能力）和深度学习（一种训练计算机像人脑一样学习和工作的AI方法），帮助研究者更快地处理图像。

ex.s: “Our cooperation is truly proof of what makes Salk science so special and impactful,” says Pereira.
ex.t: "我们的合作真正证明了萨尔克科学的特殊性和影响力，"佩雷拉说。

ex.s: During your initial reading of material, do you ever go back and reread sentences or paragraphs?
ex.t: 在你对材料的初步阅读过程中,你是否曾经回去重新阅读句子或段落?

ex.s: Napping and daydreaming are habits caused by lack of involvement with the material.
ex.t: 打盹和白日梦是由于缺乏对材料的投入而形成的习惯。

ex.s: Be demanding on yourself and expect 100 percent attention to the task.
ex.t: 对自己严格要求，期待百分之百的注意力投入到任务中。

ex.s: I missed that paragraph because I was thinking of something else, but I’m going to keep on going and start paying close attention.”
ex.t: 我漏看了那一段，因为我在想别的事情，但我会继续读下去，并开始集中注意力。"

ex.s: Ivy and Mia were best friends.
ex.t: 艾薇和米娅是最好的朋友。

ex.s: The teachers praised her, and friends gathered around her, requesting her to sing.
ex.t: 老师们称赞她，朋友们围在她身边，请求她唱歌。

ex.s: Mia, however, didn’t know it and went her way as usual.
ex.t: 然而，米娅并不知道这些，依然像往常一样走自己的路。

ex.s: My dad and I were at a grocery store last evening.
ex.t: 当收银员扫描完所有商品后，爸爸伸手去拿钱包，却愣住了。

ex.s: When the cashier rang everything up, my dad reached for his wallet and froze.
ex.t: 当收银员把所有东西扫码结算后，我爸爸伸手去拿钱包，却愣住了。

ex.s: A family member is returning from a year-long trip, and you are meeting her at the airport.
ex.t: 一位家人结束长达一年的旅行归来，你正在机场接她。

ex.s: We welcome volunteers to help transform reclaimed materials into objects with new and creative purposes.
ex.t: 我们欢迎志愿者帮忙将回收材料改造成具有崭新而富有创意用途的物品。

ex.s: Furniture Restoration: take an active role in transforming reclaimed furniture and materials into useful items, giving them a new life;
ex.t: 创意工作坊：学习旧家具的基本维修和艺术改造，同时与 fellow 志愿者分享知识和想法，

ex.s: Creative Workshops: learn basic repairs and artistic redesign of old furniture, while sharing knowledge and ideas with fellow volunteers,
ex.t: 社会与环境行动：通过创造力和合作帮助应对社会和环境挑战。

ex.s: Social & Environmental Action: help address social and environmental challenges through creativity and cooperation.
ex.t: 社区服务：通过为有需要的人提供升级改造物品来支持社区，并通过社交平台推广项目以扩大影响范围。

ex.s: Community Services: support communities by providing upcycled goods to those in need and help promote projects through social platforms to widen outreach.
ex.t: 社区服务：通过向有需要的人提供升级改造的物品来支持社区，并通过社交平台帮助推广项目以扩大影响范围。

ex.s: After we had twins and became a family of five, my husband and I decided to move from London back to Yorkshire, to be closer to my parents.
ex.t: 在有了双胞胎、成为一个五口之家后，我和丈夫决定从伦敦搬回约克郡，以便离我的父母更近。

ex.s: Packing up my parents’ house felt like a massive goodbye — that bedroom, those memories, the feeling of safety and shelter I always felt there.
ex.t: 收拾父母家的房子感觉像一场盛大的告别——那间卧室、那些记忆、我在那里始终感到的安全和庇护。

ex.s: There was a silence as Dad continued to drink his tea, and I held my breath.
ex.t: 当爸爸继续喝他的茶时，一阵沉默，我屏住了呼吸。

ex.s: But smell is often overlooked and undervalued.
ex.t: 但嗅觉常常被忽视和低估。

ex.s: So, as climate change and biodiversity loss threaten natural scents, many people may not even notice.
ex.t: 无论我们是否关注世界的"气味景观"，热浪和污染正在使其发生变化。

ex.s: Whether or not we pay attention to the world’s “scentscape”, heat and pollution are causing it to shift.
ex.t: 无论我们是否关注世界的“气味景观”，高温和污染都在使它发生变化。

ex.s: “If you go to a forest, you have a given environment and temperature.
ex.t: “如果你走进森林，你就处在一个既定的环境和温度中。

ex.s: “And therefore, the perception of how the forest smells changes.”
ex.t: 这种影响不仅限于森林。

ex.s: Even though we have other valuable things endangered by climate change, like food access, there is also an element of cultural identity, cultural survival, and history.
ex.t: 尽管我们还有其他因气候变化而受到威胁的宝贵事物，比如食物获取，但这里也有文化认同、文化存续和历史的元素。

ex.s: It’s an attitude best summed up as “Move fast and break things.”
ex.t: 这种态度可概括为“快速行动，打破陈规”。

ex.s: Chesterton identified the core problem with moving fast and breaking things through a thought experiment.
ex.t: Chesterton通过一个思想实验指出了“快速行动、打破陈规”的核心问题。

ex.s: Most of us have experienced both how good it can feel and how hard it can be to do the right thing.
ex.t: 帮助陌生人会让你获得深深的满足感，但你很可能也感受过在自己已经疲惫不堪时还要为他人付出的压力。

ex.s: Instead, people with stronger moral character tend to experience greater meaning in life and happiness.

ex.s: Studies have shown that it calculates the effort required for actions and tends to stop us from squandering vital resources on fruitless efforts, like walking over 30 km for a handful of berries.
ex.t: 研究表明，它会计算某项行动所需的努力，并倾向于阻止我们把宝贵的资源浪费在徒劳的努力上，比如走30多公里只为摘一把浆果。

ex.s: Our brains can form multiple long-term goals and ambitions.
ex.t: 我们的大脑能够形成多个长期目标和抱负。

ex.s: And your “ought” self is the self that does what you ought to be doing to become your “ideal” self.
ex.t: 但随着减废的月份持续下去，我在自己力所能及的范围内尽我所能。

ex.s: As far as your brain is concerned, there are processes that discourage exercise, and processes that encourage it.
ex.t: 就你的大脑而言，有些过程会阻碍锻炼，有些过程则会促进锻炼。

ex.s: Clearly, my way of reading the text had shifted, and I myself had changed over the years.
ex.t: 显然，我阅读文本的方式已经改变，而这些年来我自己也变了。

ex.s: The original reading was either forgotten or so totally absorbed that the new chance encounter with the text produced surprise and astonishment.
ex.t: 最初的阅读要么被遗忘了，要么被完全吸收，以至于再次偶然遇到这段文字时产生了惊讶和震撼。

ex.s: It works best with poetry and music.
ex.t: 它在诗歌和音乐方面效果最好。

ex.s: I guess I was better than the others, for Miss Chevalier asked a while later, “Addie, I was wondering if you would recite the whole poem to the Saturday evening’s club.” She said a famous professor was going to give a lecture about the poet, and a presentation of that poem would be a fresh way to start.
ex.t: 我想我比其他人强一些，因为谢瓦利埃小姐过了一会儿问道："艾迪，我在想你是否愿意在周六晚上的读书会上把整首诗背诵出来。"她说一位著名教授将要做一个关于这位诗人的讲座，而朗诵那首诗会是一个新颖的开场方式。

ex.s: Halfway through the poem, Miss Chevalier stopped me and asked if I knew what “impetuous” meant.
ex.t: 诗读到一半时，Chevalier小姐让我停下来，问我知道"impetuous"是什么意思吗。

ex.s: Miss Chevalier pretended not to have noticed my red face and handed me a dictionary, asking me to read its definition aloud.
ex.t: 谢瓦利埃小姐假装没注意到我涨红的脸，递给我一本字典，让我大声读出其中的释义。

ex.s: Caring and considerate.
ex.t: 关心他人且体贴周到。

ex.s: Easygoing and carefree.
ex.t: 齐亚德开始做准备。

ex.s: Curious and open-minded.
ex.t: 好奇且思想开明。

ex.s: Disciplined and strong-willed.
ex.t: 自律且意志坚强。

ex.s: Exercise is good for you, and polluted air isn’t）.
ex.t: 锻炼对你有益，而受污染的空气则不然。

ex.s: Still, sometimes our assumptions are incorrect, and scientific findings surprise researchers, along with the rest of us.
ex.t: 尽管如此，有时候我们的假设是不正确的，科学发现会让研究人员和我们其他人感到惊讶。

ex.s: Eventually, researchers made a prediction that progressive warming during the 21st and 22nd centuries would dry out the Arctic, and lakes would begin to shrink.
ex.t: 最终，研究人员做出预测：21和22世纪逐步变暖将使北极变干，湖泊将开始萎缩。

ex.s: The frozen solid ground actually contains bits of rock, mineral and organic matter, leaving spaces in between.
ex.t: 冻得坚硬的地面实际上包含岩石、矿物和有机物的微粒，在它们之间留下了空隙。

ex.s: And because these spaces are filled with solid ice, liquid water cannot readily get inside, but it can when the permafrost melts, allowing more water to get through.
ex.t: 由于这些空间充满了坚实的冰，液态水不容易进入其中，但当永久冻土融化时就可以，从而让更多的水渗透过去。

ex.s: Awake from a short sleep in her chair, my grandmother ran her fingers through her wavy white hair, looked out her window at the blue sky, and asked me what I would wish for if I had just one wish.
ex.t: 祖母从椅子上的短暂小睡中醒来，手指捋过波浪般的白发，望向窗外蓝天，问我如果只有一个愿望，我会许什么愿。

ex.s: She often asks this, and I always answer the same way—“To have Granddad back” —which usually gets her reminiscing about him.
ex.t: 她常这么问，而我也总是同样的回答——“让爷爷回来”——这通常会让她陷入对他的回忆。

ex.s: Even at 93, my grandmother still knits blankets for the local hospital’s babies and buys books to continue with her French.
ex.t: 即使到了93岁，我的祖母仍然为当地医院的婴儿织毯子，还买书继续学法语。

ex.s: Studies show teaching children how to cook at an early age helps with reading comprehension and fine motor ability, in addition to learning about nutrition and food safety.
ex.t: 研究表明，尽早教孩子做饭有助于提高阅读理解能力和精细动作能力，此外还能让他们了解营养和食品安全。

ex.s: “I love working with kids, so I just decided to take a spare bedroom and turn it into a one-room cooking school called Sprouts Cooking School. ”
ex.t: "我喜欢和孩子们一起工作，所以我决定腾出一间闲置卧室，把它改造成一个名为'豆芽烹饪学校'的单间烹饪学校。"

ex.s: Younger kids might make cookies while older ones are cooking soup and meatballs.
ex.t: 较小的孩子可能做饼干，较大的孩子则煮汤、做肉丸。

ex.s: There are birthday parties and summer camps as well.
ex.t: 还有生日派对和夏令营。

ex.s: Please give one example and explain why. (no more than 20 words)
ex.t: 请举一例并说明原因。（不超过20个词）

ex.s: I entered the room and the teachers made me say some lines from the musical.
ex.t: 我走进房间，老师们让我念了音乐剧里的几句台词。

ex.s: The teachers were smiling and praising me.
ex.t: 老师们微笑着称赞我。

ex.s: My friends checked and came back shouting, “Amy, you got the main role! ” Sure enough, my name was at the top.
ex.t: 我的朋友们查看后跑回来喊道："艾米，你拿到主角了！"果然，我的名字在最上面。

ex.s: After two months we were all prepared and ready to go on stage.
ex.t: 两个月后，我们都准备好了，可以登台了。

ex.s: His glasses went flying and landed in the grass.
ex.t: 他的眼镜飞了出去，落在草地上。

ex.s: As I handed him the glasses, he looked at me and said, “Thanks!”
ex.t: 当我把眼镜递给他时，他看着我说："谢谢！"

ex.s: Students record short entries after each partner meeting noting the language skills practised and the topics discussed.
ex.t: 学生在每次搭档见面后记录简短条目，注明练习的语言技能和讨论的话题。

ex.s: The sign-up and registration process is as follows:
ex.t: 报名和注册流程如下：

ex.s: •Students sign up and indicate the languages they can share and languages they are interested in learning.
ex.t: •学生报名并注明他们能够分享的语言和他们有兴趣学习的语言。

ex.s: Signing up for the programme does not automatically mean that you will be able to register and participate.
ex.t: 报名该项目并不自动意味着你将能够注册并参与。

ex.s: Pairs are matched by languages of interest and proficiency levels.
ex.t: 配对根据兴趣语言和熟练程度进行匹配。

ex.s: Since there are many factors involved in the pairing process, not all students who sign up will be matched with a partner and be able to register for the programme.
ex.t: 由于配对过程中涉及许多因素，并非所有报名的学生都能匹配到搭档并注册该项目。

ex.s: When I was a little girl, I liked drawing, freely and joyously making marks on the walls at home.
ex.t: 当我还是个小女孩时，我喜欢画画，自由而快乐地在家里墙上涂画。

ex.s: But other channels of creativity stayed open: I went on writing poems and stories.
ex.t: 但其他创造力的渠道依然敞开：我继续写诗和故事。

ex.s: In my 30s, I made painter friends and learned new ways of looking at art.
ex.t: 在我三十多岁时，我交了一些画家朋友，学会了欣赏艺术的新方式。

ex.s: One night, in my early 40s, I dreamed that a big woman in red approached me, handed me a bag of paints, and told me to start painting.
ex.t: 在我40岁出头的一个夜晚，我梦见一个穿红衣的高大女人走近我，递给我一袋颜料，让我开始画画。

ex.s: Although I have enjoyed breaking my decades-long taboo about working with oil paints, I have discovered I now prefer chalks and ink.
ex.t: 虽然我很享受打破几十年来不用油画创作的禁忌，但我发现自己现在更喜欢粉笔和墨水。

ex.s: It all feels free and easy.
ex.t: 一切感觉轻松自在。

ex.s: That dream reminded me that those fears and desires could encourage me to take risks and make experiments.
ex.t: 那个梦提醒我，那些恐惧和欲望可以鼓励我去冒险和尝试。

ex.s: While he held the notion that objective reality exists, he said our mind plays a necessary role in structuring and shaping our perceptions.
ex.t: 虽然他持有客观现实存在的观念，但他说我们的心智在构建和塑造我们的感知中扮演着必要的角色。

ex.s: Now that we are in the information age, we have new concepts such as the computer, information processing, virtual reality, and simulation.
ex.t: 既然我们处于信息时代，我们就有了计算机、信息处理、虚拟现实和模拟等新概念。

ex.s: All these models are tools to deal with the unknown and to make discoveries.
ex.t: 所有这些模型都是应对未知和做出发现的工具。

ex.s: And the more tools we have, the more effective and insightful we can become.
ex.t: 我们拥有的工具越多，我们的效率和洞察力就越强。

ex.s: Dishonest and violent behaviours were disapproved of; leadership, marriage and interactions with other groups were loosely governed by traditions.
ex.t: 不诚实和暴力行为受到反对；领导地位、婚姻和与其他群体的交往则由传统松散地约束。

ex.s: The similarity of moral virtues across cultures is striking, even though the relative ranking of the virtues may vary with a social group’s history and environment.
ex.t: 道德美德在各文化间的相似性令人惊叹，尽管这些美德的相对排序可能随社会群体的历史和环境而变化。

ex.s: Typically, cruelty and cheating are discouraged, while cooperation, humbleness and courage are praised.
ex.t: 通常，残忍和欺骗受到谴责，而合作、谦逊和勇气则受到赞扬。

ex.s: These social emotions prepare our brains to shape our behaviour according to the norms and values of our family and our community.
ex.t: 这些社会情感使我们的大脑做好准备,根据我们家庭和社区的规范和价值观塑造我们的行为。

ex.s: Our brains use the system to acquire behavioural patterns regarding safe routes home, efficient food gathering and dangers to avoid.
ex.t: 我们的大脑利用这一系统习得有关安全回家路线、高效觅食以及需要避开的危险的行为模式。

ex.s: Good habits save time, energy and sometimes your life.
ex.t: 好习惯节省时间、精力，有时还能救命。

ex.s: We acquire what we call a sense of right and wrong.
ex.t: 我们获得了所谓的是非感。

ex.s: According to Isaiah Berlin, the hedgehog knows one thing very well, and the fox knows a lot of things.
ex.t: 根据以赛亚·伯林的观点，刺猬把一件事懂得很透，而狐狸懂得很多件事。

ex.s: They focus on one thing and do it really well.
ex.t: 他们专注于一件事并且做得非常好。

ex.s: They also have a clearer estimation of what they know and don’t know.
ex.t: 它们也对自己知道和不知道什么有更清晰的估计。

ex.s: Hence, they have the advantage of clarity and confidence.
ex.t: 因此，他们拥有清晰和自信的优势。

ex.s: However, hedgehogs remain open to others’ reactions and inputs.
ex.t: 然而，刺猬仍然对其他人的反应和意见持开放态度。

ex.s: They come down squarely on one side or the other and fully support their position.
ex.t: 他们明确地站在某一边，全力支持自己的立场。

ex.s: When I decided to pursue a postgraduate degree, I wanted to develop a novel research programme and quickly establish myself as an independent scientist.
ex.t: 当我决定攻读研究生学位时，我想开发一个新颖的研究项目，并迅速确立自己作为独立科学家的地位。

ex.s: Cycling is the most economical, sustainable and fun way to explore the city, with its beautiful canals, parks, squares and countless lights.
ex.t: 骑自行车是最经济、可持续且有趣的城市探索方式，这里有美丽的运河、公园、广场和无数的灯光。

ex.s: MacBike has been around for almost 30 years and is the biggest bicycle rental company in Amsterdam.
ex.t: MacBike已经存在近30年，是阿姆斯特丹最大的自行车租赁公司。

ex.s: The 2.5-hour tour covers the Gooyer Windmill, the Skinny Bridge, the Rijksmuseum, Heineken Brewery and much more.
ex.t: 2.5小时的游览涵盖古伊风车、瘦桥、国立博物馆、喜力啤酒厂等地。

ex.s: How much do you pay for renting a bike with hand brake and three gears for two days?
ex.t: 租一辆带手刹和三挡的自行车两天要付多少钱？

ex.s: A dirty stream, for example, often became clear after flowing through plants and along rocks where tiny creatures lived.
ex.t: 例如，一条污浊的小溪在流经植物和栖息着微小生物的岩石后，常常变得清澈。

ex.s: After studying agriculture, medicine, and fisheries in college, John went back to observing nature and asking questions.
ex.t: 在大学学了农业、医学和渔业后，约翰回去观察自然并提出问题。

ex.s: With the right combination of animals and plants, he figured, maybe he could clean up waste the way nature did.
ex.t: 他想，通过正确的动植物组合，也许他能像大自然那样清理废物。

ex.s: He placed them in the tanks and waited.
ex.t: 他把它们放进水箱里等待。

ex.s: The plants and animals in the eco-machine took the sludge as food and began to eat it!
ex.t: 生态机器中的植物和动物把污泥当作食物，开始吃掉它！

ex.s: Within weeks, it had all been digested, and all that was left was pure water.
ex.t: 几周内，污泥全被消化了，剩下的只有纯净水。

ex.s: You’ll hear these participants’ stories and learn what strategies worked well for them, and what traps they encountered that you should avoid.
ex.t: 你将听到这些参与者的故事，了解哪些策略对他们有效，以及他们遇到了哪些你应当避免的陷阱。

ex.s: Some people will tend to overestimate, and some to underestimate.
ex.t: 有些人倾向于高估，有些人倾向于低估。

ex.s: Most frequently, the groups reported that they “shared arguments and reasoned together.” Somehow, these arguments and reasoning resulted in a global reduction in error.
ex.t: 最常见的情况是,这些小组报告说,它们“分享论点,共同推理”。 不知何故,这些论点和推理导致全球误差减少。

ex.s: Although the studies led by Navajas have limitations and many questions remain the potential implications for group discussion and decision-making are enormous.
ex.t: 尽管纳瓦哈斯主导的研究存在局限性且仍有许多问题未解决，但其对小组讨论和决策的潜在影响是巨大的。

ex.s: The dumplings arrive steaming and dangerously hot.
ex.t: 小笼包端上来时热气腾腾，烫得吓人。

ex.s: Writing was so difficult and painful for me that my teacher had allowed me to present my paper on the sinking of the Titanic by acting out a play, where I played all the parts.
ex.t: 写作对我来说太困难、太痛苦，以至于老师允许我通过表演一出戏来呈现关于泰坦尼克号沉没的论文，在戏里我扮演了所有角色。

ex.s: Not a brilliant idea, but funny; and unlikely to be anyone else’s choice.
ex.t: 不是个绝妙的主意，但很有趣；而且不太可能是别人的选择。

ex.s: When I handed in the essay to my teacher, he read it, laughed out loud, and said, “Great.
ex.t: 当我把文章交给老师时，他读了之后放声大笑，说：“很好。

ex.s: Now, write it again.” I wrote it again, and again and again.
ex.t: 现在，再写一遍。”我一遍又一遍地重写。

ex.s: What is the relationship between Mark and Ashley?
ex.t: 马克和阿什利是什么关系？

ex.s: Yellowstone National Park offers a variety of ranger programs throughout the park and throughout the year.
ex.t: 黄石国家公园全年在园内提供各种各样的护林员项目。

ex.s: Learn where to look for animals and how to safely enjoy your wildlife watching experience.
ex.t: 学习在哪里寻找动物，以及如何安全地享受观察野生动物的体验。

ex.s: Kids can test their skills and compare their abilities to the animals of Yellowstone.
ex.t: 孩子们可以测试自己的技能，并把能力与黄石公园的动物比较。

ex.s: Enhance your photography skills — join Yellowstone’s park photographer for a hands-on program to inspire new and creative ways of enjoying the beauty and wonder of Yellowstone.
ex.t: 提升你的摄影技巧——加入黄石公园摄影师的实践项目，激发享受黄石之美与奇迹的新颖创意方式。

ex.s: Turning soil, pulling weeds, and harvesting cabbage sound like tough work for middle and high school kids.
ex.t: 翻土、拔草和收卷心菜，对中学生和高中生来说听起来像是艰苦的劳动。

ex.s: And at first it is, says Abby Jaramillo, who with another teacher started Urban Sprouts, a school garden program at four low-income schools.
ex.t: 起初确实如此，阿比·哈拉米略说，她和另一位老师创办了"城市新芽"——一个在四所低收入学校开展的校园菜园项目。

ex.s: The program aims to help students develop science skills, environmental awareness, and healthy lifestyles.
ex.t: 该项目旨在帮助学生培养科学技能、环境意识和健康的生活方式。

ex.s: Jaramillo’s students live in neighborhoods where fresh food and green space are not easy to find and fast food restaurants outnumber grocery stores.
ex.t: 哈拉米略的学生居住的社区里，新鲜食物和绿地很难找到，快餐店的数量超过了杂货店。

ex.s: “The kids literally come to school with bags of snacks and large bottles of soft drinks,” she says.
ex.t: “孩子们真的是带着一袋袋零食和大瓶软饮料来上学的，”她说。

ex.s: “They come to us thinking vegetables are awful, dirt is awful, insects are awful.” Though some are initially scared of the insects and turned off by the dirt, most are eager to try something new.
ex.t: “他们来找我们时，认为蔬菜很讨厌，泥土很讨厌，昆虫很讨厌。”虽然有些人一开始害怕昆虫、厌恶泥土，但大多数人都渴望尝试新事物。

ex.s: Urban Sprouts’ classes, at two middle schools and two high schools, include hands-on experiments such as soil testing, flower-and-seed dissection, tastings of fresh or dried produce, and work in the garden.
ex.t: “城市萌芽”的课程在两所初中和两所高中开设，内容包括动手实验，如土壤检测、花和种子的解剖、品尝新鲜或晒干的农产品，以及在菜园里劳动。

ex.s: Several times a year, students cook the vegetables they grow, and they occasionally make salads for their entire schools.
ex.t: 一年里好几次，学生们烹饪他们种出的蔬菜，偶尔还会为全校做沙拉。

ex.s: “They get outside,” she says, “and they feel successful.”
ex.t: “他们走到户外，”她说，“而且他们感到自己很有成就感。”

ex.s: In artists’ representations of books and reading, we see moments of shared humanity that go beyond culture and time.
ex.t: 在艺术家对书籍和阅读的描绘中，我们看到了超越文化与时代的、人类共有的瞬间。

ex.s: More recently, as books have become inexpensive or even throwaway, artists have used them as the raw material for artworks — transforming covers, pages or even complete volumes into paintings and sculptures.
ex.t: 更近一些时候，随着书籍变得廉价甚至可以随意丢弃，艺术家们开始把它们用作艺术品的原材料——把封面、书页甚至整册书变成绘画和雕塑。

ex.s: And in contrast to our increasingly networked lives where the information we consume is monitored and tracked, a printed book still offers the chance of a wholly private, “off-line” activity.
ex.t: 与我们日益网络化的生活——我们所消费的信息被监控和追踪——形成对比的是，印刷书仍提供一种完全私密、"离线"活动的机会。

ex.s: Wealth and intellect.
ex.t: 财富与智慧。

ex.s: Home and school.
ex.t: 家庭与学校。

ex.s: Books and reading.
ex.t: 书籍与阅读。

ex.s: Work and leisure.
ex.t: 工作与休闲。

ex.s: Past research has found health and wellness benefits of nature for humans, but a new study shows that wildness in urban areas is extremely important for human well-being.
ex.t: 过去的研究发现了大自然对人类健康和幸福的益处，而一项新研究表明，城市中的自然野趣对人类的幸福极其重要。

ex.s: For example, one participant’s experience of “We sat and listened to the waves at the beach for a while” was assigned the categories “sitting at beach” and “listening to waves.”
ex.t: 例如，一位参与者"我们坐在海滩上听了一会儿海浪"的体验被归入"坐在海滩"和"听海浪"两类。

ex.s: Naming each nature experience creates a usable language, which helps people recognize and take part in the activities that are most satisfying and meaningful to them.
ex.t: 为每种自然体验命名创造出一种可用的语言，帮助人们认识并参与那些对他们来说最令人满足、最有意义的活动。

ex.s: And for that to happen, we also need to protect nature so that we can interact with it,” said Peter Kahn, a senior author of the study.
ex.t: 而要做到这一点，我们还需要保护自然，这样我们才能与之互动，该研究的资深作者彼得·卡恩说。

ex.s: By the early 1970s, after centuries of cruel and continuous hunting by settlers, 600 to 800 grizzlies remained on a mere 2 percent of their former range in the Northern Rockies.
ex.t: 到20世纪70年代初，在定居者几个世纪残酷而持续的捕猎之后，在北部落基山脉，仅剩600到800只灰熊栖息在它们昔日活动范围的区区2%的土地上。

ex.s: Today, there are about 2,000 or more grizzly bears in the US Their recovery has been so successful that the US Fish and Wildlife Service has twice attempted to delist grizzlies, which would loosen legal protections and allow them to be hunted.
ex.t: 如今，美国大约有2000只或更多的灰熊。它们的恢复如此成功，以至于美国鱼类和野生动物管理局曾两次试图将灰熊从保护名录中移除，这将放松法律保护并允许捕猎它们。

ex.s: If people remove food and attractants from their yards and campsites, grizzlies will typically pass by without trouble.
ex.t: 如果人们把食物和引诱物从自家院子和营地清除，灰熊通常会顺利通过而不惹麻烦。

ex.s: Putting electric fencing around chicken houses and other farm animal quarters is also highly effective at getting grizzlies away.
ex.t: 在鸡舍和其他家畜栏舍周围安装电围栏，对驱赶灰熊也非常有效。

ex.s: “Our hope is to have a clean, attractant-free place where bears can pass through without learning bad habits,“ says James Jonkel, longtime biologist who manages bears in and around Missoula.
ex.t: 我们的希望是拥有一个干净、无诱饵的地方，让熊可以穿行而过而不养成坏习惯，长期在米苏拉及周边管理熊的生物学家詹姆斯·琼克尔说。

ex.s: Even though Britain has a reputation for less-than-impressive cuisine, it is producing more top class chefs who appear frequently on our television screens and whose recipe books frequently top the best seller lists.
ex.t: 尽管英国以平庸的烹饪闻名，但它正在培养出更多一流厨师，他们频繁出现在电视屏幕上，其食谱书也经常登上畅销榜榜首。

ex.s: It’s thanks to these TV chefs rather than any advertising campaign that Britons are turning away from meat-and-two-veg and ready-made meals and becoming more adventurous in their cooking habits.
ex.t: 多亏了这些电视厨师而不是任何广告宣传活动，英国人正在远离“一肉两菜”和即食餐，在烹饪习惯上变得更具冒险精神。

ex.s: It is recently reported that the number of those sticking to a traditional diet is slowly declining and around half of Britain’s consumers would like to change or improve their cooking in some way.
ex.t: 最近有报道称，坚持传统饮食的人数正在缓慢下降，约一半英国消费者想以某种方式改变或改善自己的烹饪。

ex.s: There has been a rise in the number of students applying for food courses at UK universities and colleges.
ex.t: 申请英国高校食品课程的学生数量有所上升。

ex.s: One in four adults say that TV chefs have made them much more confident about expanding their cookery knowledge and skills, and young people are also getting more interested in cooking.
ex.t: 四分之一的成年人说，电视上的厨师让他们对拓展自己的烹饪知识和技能更有信心，年轻人也对烹饪越来越感兴趣。

ex.s: Cookery shows and documentaries about food are broadcast more often than before.

ex.s: As Kristian Hammond, professor of electrical engineering and computer science at Northwestern University, put it: “There’s never a stage at which the system knows what it’s talking about.”
ex.t: 正如西北大学电气工程与计算机科学教授克里斯蒂安·哈蒙德所言：系统从来没有一个阶段知道自己到底在说什么。

ex.s: What Hammond is referring to is the question of meaning and meaning is central to what distinguishes the least intelligent of humans from the most intelligent of machines.
ex.t: 哈蒙德指的是意义问题，而意义是将最不聪明的人类与最聪明的机器区分开来的核心所在。

ex.s: Humans, in thinking, talking, reading and writing, also work with symbols.
ex.t: 人类在思考,交谈,阅读和写作中,也用符号工作.

ex.s: The rules that assign meaning lie not just inside our heads, but also outside, in society, in social memory, social conventions and social relations.
ex.t: 赋予意义的规则不仅存在于我们头脑内部，也存在于外部——在社会中，在社会记忆、社会惯例和社会关系中。

ex.s: But all of that growth will take up a lot of space, and though more and more people accept the concept of solar energy, few like large solar panels to be installed near them.
ex.t: 但所有这些增长都会占用大量空间，而且尽管越来越多的人接受太阳能的概念，却很少有人喜欢附近安装大型太阳能板。

ex.t: 太阳能开发商希望尽可能快速廉价地安装电池板，所以他们没有过多考虑电池板下面放置什么。

ex.s: “They need to be protectors of the land and contribute to the agricultural economy.” InSPIRE is investigating practical approaches to “low-impact” solar development, which focuses on establishing and operating solar farms in a way that is kinder to the land.
ex.t: “它们需要成为土地的保护者，并为农业经济做出贡献。”InSPIRE正在研究“低影响”太阳能开发的实用方案，重点关注以一种对土地更友好的方式建立和运营太阳能农场……

ex.s: Over 28 states have passed laws related to pollinator habitat protection and pesticide use.
ex.t: 超过28个州已通过与传粉昆虫栖息地保护和杀虫剂使用相关的法律。

ex.s: Conservation organizations put out pollinator-friendliness guidelines for home gardens, businesses, schools, cities—and now there are guidelines for solar farms.
ex.t: 保护组织发布了针对家庭花园、企业、学校和城市的传粉昆虫友好指南——现在也有了针对太阳能农场的指南。

ex.t: 过去几年里，许多太阳能农场开发商把太阳能板下的空间改造成了各种传粉昆虫的庇护所，从而改善了土壤并减少了碳排放。

ex.t: 大多数有常识的人都会接受，我们能够也应该从意外的失败中学习。

ex.t: 我和他一起参加了一个讲座前的晚餐，那种较小的环境让我慢慢积蓄勇气与他一对一交谈——这曾经看似完全不可能。

ex.s: Shortly after I received his invitation, applications to join the Youth for Nature and the Youth for Planet groups were sent around through my high school.
ex.t: 不久,我收到了他的邀请, 申请加入 " 青年为自然 " 和 " 青年为星球 " 团体 通过我的高中。

ex.s: They say good things come to those who wait; I say: grab every opportunity with everything you have and be impatient.
ex.t: 他们说好事会降临在懂得等待的人身上；我说：用你拥有的一切抓住每个机会，并且要迫不及待。

ex.s: They found it hard to answer, she wrote later, because imagining something that isn’t part of real life—and learning how to make it real—is a rare skill.
ex.t: 她后来写道，他们发现很难回答，因为想象不属于真实生活的东西——并学会如何让它成真——是一种罕见的能力。

ex.s: It is taught to artists and engineers, but much less often to scientists.
ex.t: 它被教给艺术家和工程师，但很少教给科学家。

ex.s: Crystal set out to change that, and helped to create a global movement.
ex.t: 水晶着手改变这一点，并帮助创建了一场全球运动。

ex.s: First, researchers need to identify all the players in that system; second, they must work out how they relate to each other; and third, they need to understand and quantify the impact of those relationships on each other and on those outside the system.
ex.t: 首先，研究人员需要识别该系统中的所有参与者；其次，他们必须弄清楚彼此之间的关系；第三，他们需要理解和量化这些关系对彼此以及对系统外各方的影响。

ex.s: Tracking of 150 biochemicals in food has been important in revealing the relationships between calories, sugar, fat and the occurrence of common diseases.
ex.t: 对食物中150种生化物质的追踪在揭示卡路里、糖、脂肪与常见疾病发生之间的关系方面发挥了重要作用。

ex.s: More researchers, policymakers and representatives from the food industry must learn to look beyond their direct lines of responsibility and adopt a systems approach.
ex.t: 更多研究者、政策制定者和食品行业代表必须学会超越其直接责任范围，并采用系统方法。

ex.s: As quantum computing attracts more attention and funding, researchers may mislead investors, journalists, the public and, worst of all, themselves about their work’s potential.
ex.t: 随着量子计算吸引更多关注和资金，研究者可能误导投资者、记者、公众，最糟的是，误导他们自己关于工作潜力的认知。

ex.s: If researchers can’t keep their promises, excitement might give way to doubt, disappointment and anger, Johnson warns.
ex.t: 如果研究人员不能信守承诺，兴奋可能会转变为怀疑、失望和愤怒，Johnson警告道。

ex.s: But something about quantum computing makes it especially prone to hype, Johnson suggests, perhaps because “‘quantum’ stands for something cool you shouldn’t be able to understand.” And that brings me back to Taylor, who suggested that I read his book Q for Quantum.
ex.t: 但量子计算的某些特点使其特别容易受到炒作的影响，Johnson暗示道，也许是因为"'量子'代表着你本不该理解的酷东西。"这让我回到了Taylor身边，他建议我读他的书《Q for Quantum》。

ex.s: Health and fitness help a person live a good and healthy life.
ex.t: 健康和 fitness 帮助一个人过上好而健康的生活。

ex.s: Health and fitness are interrelated to each other.
ex.t: 健康和健身相互关联。

ex.s: It also helps in keeping us calm and relaxes our mind.
ex.t: 它也有助于让我们保持冷静和放松心情。

ex.t: 从观察他妈妈和他想给孩子们更好的饮料选择的愿望出发，他想出了Fun Bottle的原始设计模型。

ex.s: When asked what advice he’d give other entrepreneurial youth, he says, “Prepare and have your family’s support.
ex.t: 当被问及会给其他创业青年什么建议时，他说：“做好准备，并获得家人的支持。”

ex.s: The hospital is very old and can no longer serve the needs of the town.
ex.t: 这家医院已经很老了，不能再满足小镇的需求了。

ex.t: 他叫着他们的名字，并询问____19____他们的家人。

ex.t: 我想到我的学业会怎样被____21____，以及所有我暂时不能再做的事。

ex.s: Life is not always easy, he would say, but you have to  30  and look for the positive.
ex.t: 生活并不总是一帆风顺，他会说，但你必须30 并寻找积极的一面。

ex.s: I often think of my exceptional roommate and of what a(n)  34  he was to me.
ex.t: 我常想起我出色的室友，以及他对于我是多么（34）的一个人。

ex.s: After a long non-stop flight, these passengers are tired and hungry.
ex.t: 经过长时间的不间断飞行后，这些乘客又累又饿。

ex.s: My job is to keep them calm and informed.
ex.t: 我的工作是让他们保持冷静和信息畅通。

ex.s: You see, a lot of them are travelling for pleasure and going to places like Miami Beach and Yellowstone Park.
ex.t: 你看，他们中很多是去游玩的，去的是迈阿密海滩、黄石公园之类的地方。

ex.s: But now they are out of breath and sweating.
ex.t: 但现在他们上气不接下气，满头大汗。

ex.s: We put ourselves in the passengers’ shoes and help them as much as we can.
ex.t: 我们设身处地为乘客着想，尽我们所能帮助他们。

ex.s: I say “Ni hao” to the Chinese and “Hola” to the Spanish.
ex.t: 我对中国人说“尼豪”,对西班牙人说“霍拉”。

ex.s: A simple greeting in their mother tongue can guarantee a smile from a total stranger and a tired traveller.
ex.t: 用他们的母语简单问候一句，就能让一个完全陌生的人和疲惫的旅客露出微笑。

ex.s: All kinds of human emotions are on display: sad (tearful goodbyes), happy (family get-togethers), anxious (waiting in a long line) and upset (missing a flight).
ex.t: 各种各样的人类情感都在展现：悲伤（含泪的告别）、快乐（家庭团聚）、焦虑（排长队等候）和沮丧（误了航班）。

ex.s: Selling food and drinks.
ex.t: 销售食品和饮料。

ex.s: The question,“What do elephants and fish have in common?" may sound strange but researchers have found that they both have a feature not observed in any other creature.
ex.t: "大象和鱼有什么共同点？"这个问题听起来可能很奇怪，但研究人员发现它们都有一个在其他生物身上没有观察到的特征。

ex.s: The fascinating part of the study for robotics is that elephants can use air suction both on ground and in water.
ex.t: 这项研究对机器人技术来说最迷人的部分是大象可以在地面和水中都使用空气吸力。

ex.s: That is a reminder of how little we know of our planet, and that we are not the only creatures with hidden complexities.
ex.t: 那提醒我们对自己星球的了解多么少，也提醒我们并非只有我们才拥有隐藏的复杂性。

ex.s: According to the researchers, what is the ability shared by both elephants and fish?
ex.t: 根据研究者的说法，大象和鱼共有的能力是什么？

ex.s: In science, what we do is both hard and, often, hard to explain.
ex.t: 在科学领域，我们所做的既困难，而且往往也难以解释。

ex.s: Familiar examples include Earth as the center of the universe and the stability of continents.
ex.t: 熟悉的例子包括地球是宇宙中心以及大陆稳定不变的观点。

ex.s: Science is a process of learning and discovery, and sometimes we learn that what we thought was right is wrong.
ex.t: 科学是一个学习和发现的过程，有时我们学到，我们原以为对的东西是错的。

ex.s: Some will say it is observation and description of the world.
ex.t: 有人说它是对世界的观察和描述。

ex.s: Others will say it is the use of experience and experiment.
ex.t: 也有人说它是经验和实验的运用。

ex.s: Scientists have bitterly argued about which methods are the best, and, as we all know, bitter arguments rarely get resolved.
ex.t: 科学家们激烈地争论哪些方法最好，而众所周知，激烈的争论很少能解决。

ex.s: In my view, science is not simple, and neither is the natural world.
ex.t: 在我看来,科学并不简单,自然世界也不简单.

ex.s: Our efforts to understand and explain the natural world are just that: efforts.
ex.t: 我们理解和解释自然界的努力仅仅是努力而已。

ex.s: The good news is that when that happens, we pick ourselves up, brush ourselves off, and get back to work.
ex.t: 好消息是，当失败发生时，我们会重新站起来，拍掉身上的灰尘，继续工作。

ex.s: They rely heavily on observation and description.
ex.t: 严重依赖观察和描述。

ex.s: Mike Sullivan, a former construction worker, took up woodworking after he and his wife, Judy, retired.
ex.t: 迈克·沙利文是一名前建筑工人，他和妻子朱迪退休后开始从事木工。

ex.s: His father earned $1 a day and couldn’t afford a New Year gift.
ex.t: 他父亲一天赚1美元，买不起新年礼物。

ex.s: Sullivan talked about it with Judy and they decided to start making wooden toys to give away to kids on New Year’s Day.
ex.t: 沙利文和朱迪谈了这事，决定开始制作木制玩具，在新年那天送给孩子们。

ex.s: The Sullivans now make about 1,500 toys each year to donate to local children’s charities, school districts and homeless shelters.
ex.t: 沙利文一家现在每年制作约1500件玩具，捐给当地的儿童慈善机构、学区和无家可归者收容所。

ex.s: Last year, the couple’s daughter started a GoFundMe to help cover the costs of some materials and tools.
ex.t: 去年，这对夫妇的女儿发起了一个GoFundMe众筹，帮助支付一些材料和工具的费用。

ex.s: I can’t just sit there and stare at a TV all day.
ex.t: 我不能只是坐在那里整天盯着电视。

ex.s: It’s one of the best-rated hostels in the city, and for good reason.
ex.t: 它是这座城市评分最高的旅舍之一，这是有充分理由的。

ex.s: It’s affordable, and it’s got a fun atmosphere without being too noisy.
ex.t: 它价格实惠，氛围有趣又不太吵。

ex.s: Staff members hold plenty of bar events for guests like free shots, bar crawls and karaoke.
ex.t: 工作人员为客人举办很多酒吧活动，如免费酒水、酒吧巡游和卡拉OK。

ex.s: If you’re looking for cleanliness and a modern hostel, look no further than Youth Station.
ex.t: 如果你想要干净现代的青旅，Youth Station是不二之选。

ex.s: It offers beautiful furnishings and beds.
ex.t: 它提供精美的家具和床铺。

ex.s: There are plenty of other benefits, too; it doesn’t charge city tax; it has both air conditioning and a heater for the rooms; it also has free Wi-Fi in every room.
ex.t: 还有很多其他好处：不收城市税；房间里有空调和暖气；每个房间还有免费Wi-Fi。

ex.s: His job is to sit beside the pianist and turn the pages of the score so the musicians don’t have to break the flow of sound by doing it themselves.
ex.t: 他的工作是坐在钢琴家旁边翻乐谱，这样音乐家就不必自己翻谱而打断音乐的流畅性。

ex.t: “我正翻页准备下一页，但翻页带起的气流把备用的谱子从谱架上吹掉了，”蒂特顿先生说，“幸好我接住了它们并放回去。”

ex.s: “He’s interested in the music, feeling every note, and I have to say: ‘Turn, turn!’ “Robert is the best page turner I’ve had in my entire life.”
ex.t: "他对音乐很投入，感受每一个音符，而我不得不说：'翻页！翻页！'罗伯特是我一生中遇到过的最好的翻谱员。"

ex.s: When the explorers first set foot upon the continent of North American, the skies and lands were alive with an astonishing variety of wildlife.
ex.t: 当探险者首次踏上北美大陆时，天空和大地充满了惊人多样的野生动物。

ex.s: Unfortunately, it took the explorers and the settlers who followed only a few decades to decimate a large part of these resources.
ex.t: 不幸的是，探险者和随后的定居者只用了几十年就毁掉了这些资源的很大一部分。

ex.s: Many people now misunderstand emotional intelligence as almost everything desirable in a person's makeup that cannot be measured by an IQ test, such as character, motivation, confidence, mental stability, optimism and "people skills." Research has shown that emotional skills may contribute to some of these qualities, but most of them move far beyond skill-based emotional intelligence.
ex.t: 现在许多人把情商误解为一个人特质中几乎所有无法用智商测试衡量的可取之处，比如性格、动力、自信、心理稳定、乐观和“人际技巧”。研究表明，情绪技能可能有助于其中一些品质，但大多数远远超出了基于技能的情商。

ex.s: The popularization of emotional intelligence has helped both the public and researchers re-evaluate the functionality of emotions and how they serve people adaptively in everyday life.
ex.t: 虽然情商持续受到大众欢迎是可取的，但我们希望这种关注能激发对情感的科学和学术研究的更大兴趣。

ex.s: Although the continuing popular appeal of emotional intelligence is desirable, we hope that such attention will excite a greater interest in the scientific and scholarly study of emotion.
ex.t: 尽管情商持续的大众吸引力是可取的，我们希望这种关注能激发对情绪科学和学术研究的更大兴趣。

ex.s: Emotional intelligence, with its focus or both head and heart, may serve to point us in the right direction.
ex.t: 情商兼顾头脑与内心，或许能为我们指明正确的方向。

ex.t: 我和丈夫一致认为这是我们吃过的最好的水果。

ex.t: 有一个不错的厨房和一张舒适的床。

ex.t: 当他们把早餐送到床上时，妈妈会多么高兴和自豪。

ex.t: 他们看过母亲在厨房做饭的样子。

ex.t: 大日子终于来了。

ex.t: 珍娜找到了面包，把两片放进鸡蛋混合物里。

ex.t: 詹娜把焦了的那片扔进水槽，放进另一片面包。

ex.t: 詹娜把烤焦的那片扔进   水池，又放进去另一片面包。

ex.t: 下一分钟粥溢出来了，把火浇灭了。

ex.t: 幸好杰夫保持冷静，迅速关掉了煤气。

ex.t: 庆幸的是，杰夫保持冷静，迅速关掉了燉气。

ex.s: But Jeff’s hand touched the hot burner and he gave a cry of pain.
ex.t: 但杰夫的手碰到了热的炉盘，他痛得叫了一声。

ex.t: 夫妻关系。

ex.t: 我们于6月1日开幕，由曼彻斯特室内乐团和尼古拉·本内代蒂呈现一套精彩的莫扎特作品节目。

ex.s: Come and work out with our qualified personal trainer, Jodie McGregor, on the grounds of the Middleton Lodge estate.
ex.t: 来和我们的合格私人教练乔迪·麦格雷戈一起，在米德尔顿洛奇庄园的场地上锻炼吧。

ex.t: 我们将于5月23日上午10点举办一场免费体验课，展示各种有效且活跃的锻炼方式。

ex.t: 我们还将讨论毡的起源、是什么让羊毛纤维变成毡，以及我们所使用工艺的原理。

ex.t: 了解建筑师、产品设计师和科学家如何在工作中运用相似的技能……

ex.s: Spot and Stripe are the first tiger cubs that have ever been born here.
ex.t: 全球范围内，动物园里有三分之一的苏门答腊虎幼崽活不到成年，所以我决定在家里全天候照顾它们。

ex.s: I've got two children—the younger one, Kynan, was extremely happy about the tigers arriving - but all of us really looked forward to being part of their lives and watching them grow.
ex.t: 我有两个孩子——小儿子凯南对老虎的到来极其高兴——但我们所有人都真的很期待成为它们生活的一部分，看着它们长大。

ex.s: I wasn't worried about bringing them into my home with my wife and kids.
ex.t: 我并不担心把它们带进我和妻子、孩子共同生活的家里。

ex.s: We'd come down in the morning to find they'd turned the room upside down, and left it looking like a zoo.
ex.t: 我们早上下楼时发现他们把房间弄得乱七八糟，让它看起来像个大动物园。

ex.s: There were some tough times and I just felt extremely tired.
ex.t: 有一些艰难的时刻，我只是感到极度疲惫。

ex.s: We had to have a bit of a production line going, making up “tiger milk”, washing baby bottles, and cleaning the floors.
ex.t: 当斑点和条纹四个月大时，它们学会了开门和跳围栏，我们知道真的是时候送它们走了。

ex.s: When Spot and Stripe were four months old, they were learning how to open doors and jump fences, and we knew it really was time for them to go.
ex.t: 当Spot和Stripe四个月大时，它们正在学习如何开门和翻越围栏，我们知道它们真的该走了。

ex.s: I'm hands-on with them every day at the zoo, and I do look back very fondly on the time that we had them.
ex.t: 我每天在动物园里亲手照料它们，也非常怀念我们拥有它们的那段时光。

ex.s: Why did the author decide to send Spot and Stripe back to the zoo?
ex.t: 作者为什么决定把斯波特和斯特赖普送回动物园？

ex.s: The project results from the difficulties many schools have in getting artists of any sort - whether an up-and-coming local musician or a major movie star - into schools to work with and inspire children.
ex.t: 该项目源于许多学校在邀请任何类型的艺术家——无论是崭露头角的本地音乐人还是大牌电影明星——进入学校与儿童合作并启发他们时所面临的困难。

ex.s: “I've seen those magic moments when children are talking to someone they are inspired by - their eyes are shining and their faces light up,” she said.

ex.t: 对我们小组来说最有收获的一天是项目日，那天我们为收集物资付出的所有努力终于汇聚在一起。当我看到我们收集到的各种物资时，我突然意识到，那天我们要制作的每一个套装最终都会送到一个伊拉克孩子手中。在过去的四个月里，我从未想象过项目完成后自己会有怎样的感受。在制作这些套装的过程中，我意识到自己已经忽略了它背后的真正意义——我只顾着把它当成又一个学校项目，而且是我想要拿高分的一个。当这些套装制作完成、准备送往海外时，那种温暖的感觉我将永远铭记。

ex.s: In the beginning，I dared myself to make a difference in the life of another person．Now that our project is over，I realize that I have affected not only one life，but ten．With our efforts，ten young boys and girls will now be able to further their education．
ex.t: 一开始我鼓起勇气想要改变另一个人的生活。现在我们的项目结束了，我意识到我影响的不只是一个生命，而是十个。通过我们的努力，十个年轻人现在将能够继续接受教育。

ex.s: The researchers analyzed video recordings of 53 child-parent pairs during everyday activities at home and found children who play with puzzles between 26 and 46 months of age have better spatial skills when assessed at 54 months of age.
ex.t: 研究者分析了53对亲子在家日常活动中的录像，发现26至46个月大时玩拼图的孩子，在54个月大评估时空间技能更好。

ex.s: The parents were asked to interact with their children as they normally would, and about half of children in the study played with puzzles at one time.
ex.t: 父母被要求像平时一样和孩子互动，研究中约一半的孩子曾同时玩拼图。

ex.s: Higher-income parents tended to have children play with puzzles more frequently, and both boys and girls who played with puzzles had better spatial skills.
ex.t: 高收入家庭的孩子更频繁地玩拼图，玩拼图的男孩和女孩都有更好的空间技能。

ex.s: However, boys tended to play with more complex puzzles than girls, and the parents of boys provided more spatial language and were more active during puzzle play than parents of girls.
ex.t: 然而，男孩往往比女孩玩更复杂的拼图，男孩的父母提供更多空间语言，并在拼图游戏中比女孩的父母更积极。

ex.s: And unplanned human activities have proved the idea of top﹣down control by top predators to be true． In the ocean， we fished for top predators such as cod on an industrial scale， while on land， we killed off large predators such as wolves． These actions have greatly affected the ecological balance．
ex.t: 而人类无计划的活动已经证明了顶级捕食者自上而下控制的观点是正确的。在海洋中，我们以工业规模捕捞鳕鱼等顶级捕食者，而在陆地上，我们消灭了狼等大型捕食者。这些行为极大地影响了生态平衡。

ex.s: We've all known people who run out of steam before they reach life's halfway mark． I'm not talking about those who fail to get to the top． We can't all get there． I'm talking about people who have stopped learning on growing because they have adopted the fixed attitudes and opinions that all too often come with passing years．
ex.t: 我们都认识这样的人，他们在到达人生的中点之前就失去了动力。我说的不是那些没能登上顶峰的人。我们不可能都到达顶峰。我说的是那些停止学习和成长的人，因为他们接受了那些常常伴随岁月流逝而来的固定态度和观念。

ex.s: The things we learn in maturity seldom involve information and skills． We learn to bear with the things we can't change． We learn to avoid self﹣pity． We learn that however much we try to please， some people are never going to love us﹣an idea that troubles at first but is eventually relaxing．
ex.t: 我们在成熟时学到的东西很少涉及信息和技能。我们学会忍受无法改变的事。我们学会避免自怜。我们学到，无论多么努力取悦，有些人永远不会爱我们——这个想法起初令人困扰，但最终令人释然。

ex.t: 博物馆免费。我们兴奋地走进去。大厅里坐着的一群人停下交谈，盯着我们看。

ex.s: There's a new frontier in 3D printing that's beginning to come into focus： food． Recent development has made possible machines that print， cook， and serve foods on a mass scale． And the industry isn't stopping there．
ex.t: 3D打印出现了一个新的前沿领域，正开始受到关注：食品。近期的发展使能够大规模打印、烹饪并供应食物的机器成为可能。而该行业并未止步于此。

ex.s: With a 3D printer， a cook can print complicated chocolate sculptures and beautiful pieces for decoration on a wedding cake． Not everybody can do that﹣it takes years of experience， but a printer makes it easy． A restaurant  in Spain uses a Foodini to "re﹣create forms and pieces" of food that are "exactly the same，" freeing cooks to complete other tasks． In another restaurant， all of the dishes and desserts it serves are 3D﹣printed， rather than farm to table．
ex.t: 有了3D打印机，厨师能打印复杂的巧克力雕塑和婚礼蛋糕上漂亮的装饰件。不是人人都能做到——那需要多年经验，但打印机让它变得简单。西班牙一家餐厅用Foodini“重现”食物的“形状和部件”，做到“完全一致”，解放厨师去完成其他任务。另一家餐厅所有菜肴甜点都是3D打印的，而非从农场到餐桌。

ex.s: B． It saves time and effort in cooking．
ex.t: B．它节省了烹饪的时间和精力。

ex.s: A child's day is filled with fascination， newness and wonder.
ex.t: 唤醒感官的第一步是停止在事情发生之前预测我们将要看到和感觉到的东西。

ex.s: Relearning the art of seeing the world around us is quite simple, although it takes practice and requires breaking some bad habits．
ex.t: 重新学习观察周围世界的艺术其实很简单，尽管需要练习，还需要改掉一些坏习惯。

ex.s: The first step in awakening senses is to stop predicting what we are going to see and feel before it occurs.
ex.t: 唤醒感官的第一步是在事情发生之前停止预测我们将要看到和感觉到什么。

ex.s: I climbed and climbed． There was nothing but just green bushes and these steps． I had to reach the top!
ex.t: 我爬了又爬。除了绿色的灌木丛和这些台阶，什么也没有。我必须到达山顶！

ex.s: Now we live in a world surrounded by the "can't do" attitudes． We all fall down． We all have doubts and regrets． Still we must climb and dream about what's at the top of our mountain． Monsters may appear or the night will fall． But never ever give up on your dream!
ex.t: 如今我们生活在一个被“做不到”态度包围的世界。我们都会跌倒。我们都有疑虑和悔恨。但我们仍须攀登，梦想山顶的风景。怪物可能出现，夜幕可能降临。但永远不要放弃你的梦想！

ex.s: Never let anyone tell you， "You can't．" Dream big and climb high！
ex.t: 永远别让任何人告诉你“你做不到”。大胆梦想，勇攀高峰！

ex.s: Before the heavy lifting began, the team assessed the root system and dug a five-foot-deep cylinder , measuring 40 feet in diameter, around the trunk to protect all essential roots.

ex.s: The term “budget line” has several related meanings, including a couple that are self- evident and a third that is not.
ex.t: “预算线”一词有几种相关含义，包括几个不言自明的，以及一个不不言自明的。

ex.s: The budget line is an elementary concept that most consumers understand intuitively without a need for graphs and equations — it's the household budget, for example.
ex.t: 预算线是一个基本概念，多数消费者凭直觉就能理解，无需图表和方程——比如家庭预算。

ex.s: Taken informally, the budget line describes the boundary of affordability for a given budget and specific goods.
ex.t: 从非正式角度看，预算线描述的是给定预算和特定商品下的支付能力边界。

ex.s: If the consumer has X amount of money and wants to buy two goods A and B, she can only purchase goods totaling X.
ex.t: 如果消费者有X金额的钱并且想购买两种商品A和B，她只能购买总计X的商品。

ex.s: One of the interesting ways the study of economics relates to human behavior generally is that a lot of economic theory is the formalization of the kind of simple concept outlined above — a consumer's informal understanding of the amount she has to spend and what that amount will buy.
ex.t: 经济学研究与一般人类行为相关的一个有趣之处是，许多经济理论是对上述简单概念——消费者对可花费金额及该金额能买到什么的非正式理解——的形式化。

ex.t: 但无论需要多长时间，这项技术都有潜力改变我们的交通系统和城市，无论是变得更好还是更糟，这取决于这种转型如何被监管。

ex.s: Recently，I conceptualized a new approach to timekeeping that's connected to circumstances on our planet，conditions that might change as a result of global warming．We're now building a clock at the Anchorage Museum that reflects the total flow of several major Alaskan rivers，which are sensitive to local and global environmental changes．We've programmed it to match an atomic clock if the waterways continue to flow at their present rate．If the rivers run faster in the future on average，the clock will get ahead of standard time．If they run slower，you'll see the opposite effect．
ex.t: 最近，我构想了一种与地球环境状况相关的新计时方法，而这些状况可能因全球变暖而改变。我们现在正在安克雷奇博物馆建造一座时钟，它反映阿拉斯加几条主要河流的总流量，这些河流对地方和全球的环境变化十分敏感。我们已对它编程：如果水道继续以目前速率流动，它就与原子钟同步；如果未来河流平均流速加快，时钟就会跑在标准时间前面；如果变慢，则会出现相反效果。
